messages:
Evan: Quick publish of lucent-13b smoke sweep. Noticed intermittent p99 spikes at long sequences, sharing numbers + config for quick triage before we dig deeper.

perf-bot: auto-report: model=lucent-13b run_id=2026-3765432100 summary: peak_tok_s=121 steady_tok_s_seq1k=88 median_ms=80 p95_ms=200 p99_ms=440

Tara: can you paste the exact serving config you used? was kv cache enabled? :thinking:

Evan: config (dev cluster):
```
model: lucent-13b
batching: enabled
dynamic_batching: true
dynamic_batch_threshold: 22
kv_cache: enabled
kv_cache.max_entries: 128
prefill_chunk_size: 2048
quantize: int8
```
prefills split at 2k to avoid OOMs.

Matt: did we change prefill_chunk_size recently? bumping chunk + int8 kernel swaps can increase cuda alloc/free noise, which shows up as tail.

Evan: we moved 1024->2048 last week. Quick compare:
- chunk=1024 => steady ~112 tok/s, p99 ~220ms
- chunk=2048 => steady ~121 tok/s, p99 ~440ms
Throughput up slightly, tail much worse.

Sasha: that pattern smells like larger temporary workspace allocations causing GPU mem pressure and synchronous cache maintenance. Can you re-run with kv_cache off to see effect on tail?

Evan: toggled it quickly:
- kv_cache=on (128) => p99 440ms
- kv_cache=off => p99 160ms, steady_tok_s 94
Turning cache off trims tail but loses throughput.

Tara: what's the kv cache hit_rate during the runs?

Evan: hit_rate ~0.60 during peak. Allocator logs show periodic 150-350ms stalls aligned with eviction events.

Matt: experiment: reduce kv entries to 64 with chunk=2048 and re-run. If hit_rate stays decent and p99 drops, that's promising. Also try staggering evictions.

Evan: kicked off three quick runs:
A) chunk=2048, kv_entries=64 (no stagger)
B) chunk=1024, kv_entries=64
C) chunk=2048, kv_entries=128, staggered-evict

perf-bot: run A: peak=112 tok/s p99=200ms hit_rate=0.57
perf-bot: run B: peak=107 tok/s p99=210ms hit_rate=0.53
perf-bot: run C: peak=119 tok/s p99=370ms hit_rate=0.60

Sasha: lowering max_entries helped tail with only a small throughput tradeoff. My working hypothesis: large chunk + large cache causes synchronized eviction/compaction leading to allocator stalls.

Tara: can we prototype an eviction jitter (stagger evict timers) and also capture cudaMalloc/cudaFree latencies across runs? that will help prove causality.

Evan: filed RINF-2061: "lucent-13b kv eviction jitter + allocator stalls" and attached raw perf logs + allocator traces; marked which perf-bot runs correspond to A/B/C.

Matt: I'll run a kernel-variant matrix on int8 kernels tomorrow to rule out quant kernel regressions, cc @Sasha.

Sasha: next steps: (1) add eviction jitter prototype (2) run single-region canary with kv_entries=64 + chunk=2048 (3) perf team to produce allocator stall heatmaps. If anyone wants local repro, ping me.

Evan: repro command used (dev harness):
```
python dev_harness/run_load.py --model lucent-13b --seq 1024 --clients 24 --duration 300 --prefill-chunk 2048 --kv-cache=on
```

Tara: nice work, Evan. Please attach exact log filenames to the ticket and tag me. :thumbsup:

Evan: uploaded logs + allocator excerpts to the ticket, noted mapping to runs A/B/C. Will wait on Matt's kernel runs before scheduling canary.

Sasha: thanks everyone  we'd plan to canary with kv_entries=64 + chunk=2048 once kernel checks are green. Closing the loop here.

Matt: thanks all :rocket:
